plan.summary: Proposed a comprehensive test plan for the `ai-search` module covering default resource creation, caller overrides, input validations for name, SKU, and replica count, and correct output wiring.

test_cases.name: default_configuration
test_cases.purpose: Verify that the search service creates successfully with default parameter values.
test_cases.expected: The search service is planned with default SKU (basic), replica count (1), disabled public network access, and disabled local authentication.

test_cases.name: caller_overrides
test_cases.purpose: Verify that sku and replica_count can be successfully overridden by the caller.
test_cases.expected: The search service is planned with standard SKU and replica count of 2.

test_cases.name: validation_name_blank
test_cases.purpose: Ensure variable validation catches empty or whitespace-only search service names.
test_cases.expected: Terraform rejects blank or whitespace-only names.

test_cases.name: validation_sku_invalid
test_cases.purpose: Ensure variable validation rejects unsupported SKUs.
test_cases.expected: Terraform rejects SKUs other than basic or standard.

test_cases.name: validation_replica_count_invalid
test_cases.purpose: Ensure variable validation enforces bounds and integer values for replica_count.
test_cases.expected: Terraform rejects replica counts outside 1-3 or non-integers.

test_cases.name: output_wiring
test_cases.purpose: Verify that module outputs correctly expose resource attributes and identity principal ID.
test_cases.expected: Outputs id, name, and principal_id are correctly populated from the azurerm_search_service resource.

findings.description: The `ai-search` module lacks native `.tftest.hcl` test files to validate resource creation, variable validations, and output wiring.

limitations: Mocked provider plans cannot verify live Azure API behavior or successful deployment.

author_rejections: HCL policy rejected proposal: NESTED_MOCK_DEFAULTS_MUST_BE_OBJECT: azurerm_search_service.identity; supply one object for all block instances, not a list.

test_cases.expected: Outputs id, private_fqdn, and principal_id match expected resource attributes.
